name: Closed guard
description: A guard position where the bottom player wraps their legs around the opponent's waist and locks the ankles.

name: Half guard
description: A position where the bottom player controls one of the opponent's legs between their own legs.

name: Butterfly guard
description: A seated open guard where the bottom player places a foot hook inside each of the opponent's thighs.

name: De la Riva guard
description: An open guard where the bottom player hooks the outside of the opponent's lead leg with their own leg, usually while gripping the ankle or sleeve.

name: Open guard
description: Any guard where the bottom player controls the opponent with their feet, legs and grips without locking the legs around the waist.

name: Mount
description: A dominant top position where one player sits astride the opponent's torso.

name: Side control
description: A dominant top position where one player pins the opponent from the side, chest on chest, perpendicular to them.

name: Back control
description: A dominant position behind the opponent with both hooks or a body triangle in and a seat belt grip on the upper body.

name: North-south
description: A pinning position where the top player lies chest down across the opponent with their head toward the opponent's feet.

name: Knee on belly
description: A top position where one player drives a knee onto the opponent's torso while staying mobile.

name: Turtle
description: A defensive position where a player is on their hands and knees with their elbows tucked in.

name: Standing
description: Both players on their feet before a takedown or guard pull.

name: Scissor sweep
description: From closed guard, the bottom player pulls the opponent forward and scissors their legs to tip them to the side and come on top.

name: Hip bump sweep
description: From closed guard, the bottom player sits up, posts a hand behind and bumps their hips into the opponent to roll them over and land in mount.

name: Flower sweep
description: From closed guard, the bottom player swings a leg like a pendulum while controlling the opponent's arm and leg to roll them over.

name: Arm drag
description: Pulling the opponent's arm across their body to move behind them or off-balance them.

name: Back take
description: Moving from a dominant or scrambling position to the opponent's back and securing hooks.

name: Double leg takedown
description: A takedown where the attacker drives forward, wraps both of the opponent's legs and brings them to the mat.

name: Single leg takedown
description: A takedown where the attacker lifts and controls one of the opponent's legs to finish them to the mat.

name: Torreando pass
description: A guard pass where the top player controls the opponent's legs at the hips or ankles and steps around them to side control.

name: Knee slice pass
description: A guard pass where the top player slices a knee across the opponent's thigh and drops into side control.

name: Hip escape from mount
description: An escape from mount where the bottom player bridges and shrimps their hips out to recover guard.

name: Bridge and roll escape
description: An escape from mount where the bottom player traps an arm and foot on the same side and bridges to roll the opponent over.

name: Armbar
description: A joint lock that hyperextends the opponent's elbow by controlling the arm between the attacker's legs and hips.

name: Triangle choke
description: A choke where the attacker traps one of the opponent's arms and the head inside a triangle of their legs.

name: Kimura
description: A shoulder lock that rotates the opponent's arm behind their back while gripping the wrist and the upper arm.

name: Americana
description: A shoulder lock that pushes the opponent's wrist toward the mat or their hip while the elbow is pinned.

name: Rear naked choke
description: A choke from back control where the attacker wraps an arm around the neck and squeezes with the biceps and forearm.

name: Guillotine choke
description: A front headlock choke where the attacker wraps an arm around the opponent's neck and lifts to compress the throat.

name: Cross collar choke
description: A gi choke where the attacker crosses their hands deep in the opponent's collars and squeezes against the neck.

name: Omoplata
description: A shoulder lock where the attacker uses their legs to trap the opponent's arm and rotate the shoulder.

name: Heel hook
description: A leg lock that twists the opponent's heel to strain the knee.

name: Straight ankle lock
description: A leg lock that pressures the opponent's Achilles tendon and ankle with the forearm.

name: D'Arce choke
description: An arm-in choke where the attacker threads an arm under the opponent's armpit and around the neck to squeeze the neck with the arm and shoulder.

name: Arm triangle choke
description: A choke where the attacker traps the opponent's head and one arm together and squeezes the neck against the shoulder.

name: Bow and arrow choke
description: A gi choke from back control where the attacker grips a collar and the opponent's leg and stretches the body out to tighten the choke.

name: Ezekiel choke
description: A choke where the attacker presses a forearm across the neck while gripping their own sleeve, often from mount or guard.
